nom: The INKEY List Ectoin Hydro-Barrier Serum

avis.texte: Love this for my dry skin. I use this after milky toner, before moisturizer and it adds an extra dose of hydration that actually last.

I have dry and dull skin. It locks in moisture and is perfect for your first serum to go underneath other serums and your moisturizer. It is great also for improving skin barrier. I started using this product after my first chemical peel and fell in love with it.

avis.titre: Like the product, hate the packaging
avis.texte: I have sensitive skin with eczema & rosacea, & this serum helped heal my skin barrier & seal in hydration. The packaging is awful, it's difficult to get it out of the pump, & the lettering fades quickly, you cant see when you're running low.

I consider this stuff a wonder drug. but one warning. it says wear it in the morning. if you wear makeup I recommend against that it will make your makeup pile. however if you wear it at night it will be fine and your skin will be good.

I really dont have anything negative to say about the products application or results because i really couldn't even evaluate it. I tried it 3 different ways but no matter what it was pilling. If i put moisturizer on top, wore under makeup, used it on its own, it pills. I'm so sad because it seems perfect otherwise!

My skin gets so dry my nose cracks and any cream makeuo i use pills off my face. I have been searching for a moisturizer that can penetrate my skin, and not form a grease layer above it. I've been using this for 2 weeks, and this is the first time in a while that my skin looks glowy in winter. I will absolutely be rebuying. One pump gets my whole face and neck. The scent is minimal. I was losing hope at the beginning, but do stick with it at lesst daily for results.
I usually use Anua's barrier serum but i had to switch to this one as i didnt want to wait for shipping. I am SO glad i did. Such a great product and my skin feels AMAZING!

avis.titre: I don't have acne, but this gave me pimples
avis.texte: I havent had acne in years, but within 2 days of using this my face broke out in several places. Something in the formula has to be clogging pores, beware.

This serum is a MIRACLE! My skin used to burn at the touch. It would get so dry and sensitive after washing my face that no moisturizer could heal - only burn! ONE PUMP of this serum and my skin was RESTORED! It's no longer dry and burning, but plump and supple with a healthy glow. This serum is my salvation!

The value of this product and the difference in my skin has been unbelievable. I bought it for the moisturizing reviews because I'm on Acutane and have been thoroughly impressed. The added benefit of my skin tone evening out was an added plus. 100% recommend

This came as part of a kit. I'm so glad I decided to get it. Skincare prices are getting out of hand so I'm looking for something I can afford. This left my skin feeling protected, moisturized, soft, and it looks healthier after a few days of using it twice a day. I like to mix it with a watery toner when I apply it on clean skin.

avis.titre: I wish they sold in larger bottle..
avis.texte: This is a holy grail for me. I use it before retinol but also to help restore my barrier FAST when I've done dumb stuff with actives. It helps clear post-blemish dryness and speeds healing of those areas. Love this so much I've bought it twice in 4 months so I just need a bigger bottle
This is an excellent serum to use before using retinol. My skin doesn't flake anymore since using this serum. I will continue to buy this product.
Leaves my skin feeling soft silky and glassy! It melts into my skin and it's sticky! Gives a long lasting hydration! Also goes great under makeup! And my makeup stays nicer!

Due to use of another product, my skin barrier got absolutely demolished. With constant use of only this product and a rich moisturiser , I was able to reverse that same in a little over a week. Now I now that prevention is definitely better that cute and that this serum will be a staple in my skincare routine!!

avis.titre: Great helper for damaged skin barrier
avis.texte: This product is amazing. With the help of this my damaged skin barrier has finally begun to revive. I love also the feel of this product.

avis.titre: I have dry skin but this was a no for me
avis.texte: It's not a bad serum, it didn't cause irritation but I didn't care for the texture. When first applied it's very sticky/tacky. It dries down quickly but it leaves that feeling that something is on your skin. It doesn't feel elegant like a serum should
I use this daily as part of routine skincare and really like how hydrated my skin is using this.
effective and doesn't break the bank. has become a staple in my skin care routine and i'm loving the results on my ageing skin.

It makes my skin look very good but it is hard to pump out of the small bottle. Also, I do not like the smell but if it ruins the product to change the scent then it is not too bad and the smell goes away. But if it doesn't change the efficacy, I would personally want a customized better smell and also no fragrance versions too if that is ok with other people etc. Thank you
This product is great, leaves skin feeling hydrated as well as fresh. Non-greasy, light and easy to apply.
This helps on the days that I apply retinol or other actives. It does protect my skin and help give me a reset throughout the night.

Was very hopeful as this has high reviews but this product just doesn't work for me. Firstly as some have said the pump mechanism is not great and that is an issue but it does pump out for me just very small amounts at a time. As far as how it performs I believe my problem is this doesn't mesh well with my other skincare which causes it to make everything on my face pull up which leave my entire routine useless if my skin isn't absorbing the skincare. If this product was life changing I'd be willing to make it work and change my other products to see if that would prevent the pilling issue but it really just isn't that good to do all of that. Wanted to return but it was too late.
Lightweight, deeply hydrating, and perfect for strengthening the skin barrier. My skin feels soothed, soft, and protected all day.

My menopausal skin crisis happened just as this product was launched. My skin was suddenly reacting to products I had used for months/years. It was red, dry, flaky and thick. I took a chance and bought the Ectoin Hydro-Barrier Serum to see if it would help. It did an amazing job of calming my skin. When I finished my first bottle, I decided to use up my old products as I hate waste. Big mistake! Within a few days, everything came back. Needless to say I'm back to the Ectoin and instantly, my skin feels calm. No burn. The photos aren't a direct before and after but show how good this has been for me overall. Amazing stuff!

I've had issues with my skin barrier for several years now and having almost finished my second bottle of this, I can say with certainty that it has helped repair my skin barrier and has made my skin feel comforted and less reactive. I hope that they never discontinue this product - it has been game changing for me!!

I bought this as an "upgrade" to the hyaluronic acid serum which I liked but didn't love. Right from the first use my skin just loves this serum. It goes on smoothly, works well under makeup and hydrates my often dry skin without feeling heavy or greasy. Over time my skin looks brighter and healthier, I guess just generally more balanced/happy. I have sensitive, dry and acne prone skin. The only downside for me is that it doesn't last as long as I'd like!

As someone with very dry skin, this serum is a true lifesaver. While the HA serum works more on the surfuce, this is a gem that works in the deeper layers of the face as well and helps restore the moisture barrier (don't forget to use ceramide serums and/or moisurisers or lipid moisturisers alongside this if your skin type is dry to completely repair said moisture barrier) while hydrating so much it feels like finding an oasis in the desert. It feels AMAZING and with consistency of use - 2 times a day is the best option - you and others will see effects really quickly. I even got compliments after a week and a half! Since my first bottle I always choose the duo because the price goes down even more and I never want to be without the Ectoin Hydro-Barrier serum, it's almost sorcery in a bottle. This feels like you're taking a shower in your face (feels much better than it sounds) while there's serious nourishment and repair afoot . A must have for dry skin types!

I have dry skin and tried many products over the years, but often with little results. Since using the Inkey List, my skin is doing much better. I was curious to try the Ectoin and I'm happy I gave it a go! It's now part of my morning routine and my skin is doing much better

I like this. Nice texture, and skin feels better afterwards. It's nice, but doesn't seem to do anything special. Probably won't purchase it again, but assume I gave my skin some extra moisture in this summer heat.

Matches perfectly with being first serum and Polyglutamic Acid Serum going on as final serum. Makes me feel more hydrated especially as I probably don't drink enough water! A little goes a long way despite having slightly dry skin
Love this, definitely seen an improvement in my skin since using it, would recommend
I love this use it everyday and I use it under my eyes . Haven't had any sensitivity with my retional since changing to this .. perfect
After applying this after facial cleanser i can feel the smoothness on my skin and it works very well. so i always have two more bottles stock.

I struggle with extremely dry skin and redness. This serum reduced my redness within a week of using it! Also helps the rest of my skincare glide on and really helps with those dry eczema spots. Wish they sold it in a bigger bottle.
I love inkey list. But am I the only person getting terrible peeling everytime I try wearing makeup over this?

avis.titre: The friend you never knew you needed
avis.texte: Your pre-hydration, hydration. Simple step to provide great plumping. Scent is a little weird, but who cares?!
I love this as prevents my skin feeling tight for the whole day and you genuinely don't need much.

I have very sensitive skin and often react to things and when I slowly can reintroduce skin care against then this is the first thing I start to use. It really helps speed up the process and get my skin back to a happy, healthier and smoother state. Love it!

avis.titre: Good but I still want the Q10 back!
avis.texte: Was really eager to try this and yes it helps for hydration/moisture but would really love it if the Q10 cream was brought back please !
Love this serum with retinol. Makes my skin less dry and really hydrated

Use this first thing at night after I wash my face. Makes my skin feel hydrated and plumped! You do need to use it right after you wash your face. It will sink into skin much easier if your skin is still slightly wet. Sometimes, if I don't add it in time, the serum pills on my neck.
This serum has a lovely smooth texture and glides on easily. It absorbs well and leaves my skin feeling lovely.
Found this has given my skin a protective layer against burning as I am a big holiday goer but use factor 50 suntan cream on my face this helps to stop your skin drying out

I bought it as my skin was looking dry, but I have not noticed any visible difference after 4 weeks of use. It also pills under my make up, and that is annoying. It would be nice to see how much is left.
Took a while to get into the routine of putting on before the serum etc , but I am finally in the habit , it works well , my skin is looking good so I'm happy.
I've been using the hyaluronic acid for a while now and decided to change for a bit. It's as good on my skin as the hyaluronic acid but it's good to try something different. No complaints.

Nice serum, especially in the summer when my skin needs some more hydration. You don't need a lot. The packaging is oke. It would be nice to see how much is left. But I really don't like the smell, it's chemical/chlorine like.

Great product, my skin has been so much better following the use of this product and my skin is looking so much healthier. Was having loads of breakouts prior and now my skin is great since I've been using this product

My skin tends dry and can be reactive, so finding a serum that hydrates effectively and supports my skin barrier is a real win. It sits well under SPF and with the Ceramide Moisturiser creates a good base for makeup.
Genuinely one of the best serums I have ever used. It feels really hydratings, and soothes my skin and makes it look less red and irritated.

I have suffered with eczema for years, struggled with breakouts on my face and had to resort to prescribed steroid based creams often ending up in a cycle of breakout followed by a reaction to the steroids. I've used this now for 3 months in conjunction with the oat cleansing balm and my skin is hydrated, glowing with no signs of eczema at all. It is so good that I now panic if I am running low ! It is an unbelievably effective product and has literally changed my life.
I love this product. I've been using in for a month or so now and can clearly see and feel that my skin is more hydrated. Fine lines are less noticeable.
First time trying this serum and makes me feel glowy every time, love it!

avis.titre: Early days but loving it so far
avis.texte: Haven't been using it long but liking it so far. At least as good as some very expensive serums I've been using and skin nice and plump and moisturised.

avis.titre: At last a serum that lights my skin.
avis.texte: It's the perfect serum for my skin. It is instantly absorbed.
This is a wonderful light but super moisturiser. I use it under the Omega Water cream and it's definitely one of my must haves!
This stuff has made the most difference to my dry skin. Could not recommend it enough. It has helped calm and hydrate a tricky patch and made a noticable difference in days.
As soon as applied, my dehydrated/dry skin feels very comfortable, more hydrated and bouncy thanks to the hydro-barrier serum.
I have been using it for a 2 months now and my skin feels and looks more glowy and hydrated. I combine it with the peptides cream.
Believe the hype-This stuff has made my horrible old skin look much better

I always apply a serum before using a moisturiser and this one is great. It has a lovely texture ,smooths and glides over your skin wonderfully. It has a rich texture and gives your skin a great barrier for underneath your moisturiser which is key. I thoroughly recommend it.
I wasn't sure what to expect as I've always used inkeys hyaluronic acid for some years. This is lovely. Makes my skin feel hydrated.

avis.titre: Who knew my skin was so dehydrated?
avis.texte: Dry skin in the winter, extra face washing and sun exposure in the summer. Trentinoin use throughout. My skin has gotten very sensitive with age. At 35 I had the worst acne of my life and I've taken many steps, made many changes and had a lot of patience to get it to a happy and healthy place. Adding this extra hydration before face drying lotions and serums has dramatically helped . My skin tone looks and feels more even and overall comfortable to be in.

Where has this skincare line been all my life? This serum seriously makes my skin feel plump, hydrated and it's so good for my skin. I was gardening one afternoon and my gardening gloves were wet inside. I gardened for almost 4 hours and when I was done, I removed my gloves and my fingers were very "pruney" due to the wet gloves. As soon as I used the serum on my face (after showering and subsequently had some of the product on my fingers), I noticed my pruney fingers started to soften and returned to normal in a matter of minutes. It was amazing!!! Glad I found this product and will use it every day after cleansing my face. THANK YOU!!
Been using this for over a month now and it has made a big difference to my skin. It's smoother and much softer. My skin looks much more healthy and glowing

avis.titre: My Go-To Hydration For My Nighttime Routine
avis.texte: As a newbie to skincare, I started paying more attention to the products I use. I only desire to use natural and healthy ingredients for my skin including this product. With this hydro barrier, I am confident in the strengthening of my skin. I researched the power of ectoin which is a natural skin strengthener if you didn't know so upon purchasing I was extremely excited to begin using. I've been using this product as my daily hydrating serum for both my night and day routine. I only use two small pumps. My skin is looking and feeling healthier, more bouncy and glowy nowadays. I haven't been disappointed and it's very gentle. I am acne prone, have oily and eczema skin, it works very well for me < 3 If you are looking for something simple but effective, for skin strengthening I highly recommend.
I use this barrier protectant am and pm to keep my sensitive skin barrier strong.

avis.titre: Feels nice but too many breakouts for me
avis.texte: My sensitive skin girlies, approach with caution! I have an unusual amount of new whiteheads anytime I use this serum, morning or night. I wish it produced results that match the way this feels on my skin!

avis.titre: Caused pilling- only use in evening
avis.texte: This product caused severe pilling, especially whenI wore makeup over it regardless of how much time I left between steps of skincare. It is probably a good product but I couldn't find a way to integrate it into my day routine.
My skin is dry, this serum did nothing for me. No improvement at all. I used it with a 1nkey moisturiser, there is nothing suitable my dry acne prone skin. Still dry and still breaking out!
Not barrier friendly. Got to help soothe from retinol sensitivity.

I have extremely sensitive skin and use Differin and finecea on alternating nights. My barrier was beyond damaged, and my skin reacts to 90% of any new products I use but this? Is incredible. It's rare for me to love a product so much but I'll be repurchasing this indefinitely!
Really pleased with this product. I mostly only use Inkey List for my skincare and my skin has been much better.

avis.titre: Not as good as I had hoped
avis.texte: Decided to give this a try, as replacement for the hyaluronic acid serum. I had started to notice that my skin was becoming dehydrated, tight and losing firmness. (I am mid 50's and have very few fine lines or wrinkles) I have used this product for approx 14 days, and I have been really disappointed. My face constantly feels tight and dry all day, and this is the only product that I have changed in my skincare routine (I only use Inkey List products). I have a selection of serums, and moisturisers and I like to change between them depending on how my skin is feeling. I won't be finishing this serum, which is disappointing as I had high expectation for this product, and I shall return to the hyaluronic acid serum.

avis.titre: Did not make a difference unfortun
avis.texte: Been using this for 6 weeks now, but cannot see any difference in my skin texture, barrier health or hydration levels. Sad, was very excited about this :(
So far so good - I love the polygutamic acid serum but wanted to switch things up, and this one is also super hydrating!

I've been using hylaronic acid for a long time and fancied a change. This is the ideal serum is beginning your daily skin care routine, it feels so light weight, sinks in really quick and a little goes a long way.
This serum is my first serum in my daily routine after I washed my face. Nice texture, not thick, not greasy but very moisturizing, sometimes I don't even need a face cream.

Permit me for using a Nigerian language there. It's just how much this hydro-barrier serum makes me happy. So some years back, I used a very terrible face cream that made my face super sensitive. Like if the slightest thing touches my face, it becomes red and sometimes itches. Then someone in Instagram talked about this serum and i ordered two. I'm almost done with one bottle and my face has changed a lot. I glow better, moisture is restored, the unsolicited redness has reduced. What ever y'all put in there, don't stop adding it. Thank you!
I'm really trying to like this serum but I'm not seeing any difference after my second bottle and it just doesn't hydrate as well as the hyaluronic acid serum on it's own.
I have dry skin and this product further dries out my skin. After use, even though I follow with a moisturizing serum and a moisturizer my skin feels very tight and very dry.
I'm really trying to like this serum but I'm not seeing any difference after my second bottle and it just doesn't hydrate as well as the hyaluronic acid serum on it's own.

avis.titre: Works great for Skin barrier protection
avis.texte: This works well to restore my skin's natural barrier, but I find it's too much if I use the Omega Water Cream too. So I rotate the two products.

avis.titre: I can feel my skin drink this
avis.texte: This si such a lovely new addition to the efforts of plumping. Applying with a nearly damp face helps lock in the moisture. Truly wonderful addition to my skin care routine.
Feel like I can't go without this now. Got one on the go and a back up!
Really lovely serum helped my dry damaged red skin recover in 2 weeks of use !!!
I layer this with other serums. It has a silky texture. The only reason that I do not give 5 stars is because of the plastic waste. I'd pay more to have eco-friendly packaging.
this helps me have an extra layer of protection in the winter
Love this serum! Goes on really easy and soaks right into the skin. Not tacky at all!
This serum has really made a difference to my skin hydration in such a short time. I'm delighted with it!

avis.titre: Feels nice, not really sure what it does
avis.texte: I've added this into my routine, but I'm really not sure if it's doing anything. Feels nice, so will use it up but might not repurchase.

I can already notice significant improvements after introducing it to my routine. I feel it strengthens the skin while I battle two stubborn melasma patches with retinol,, glicolic acid, niacidamide and vitamin c. Love the texture also!

I have been using this for a month now & it's AMAZING. I originally bought this because my skin was BURNING so bad when I put any skincare on, even my spf & moisturiser. Few google searches later I discovered my skin barrier was damaged & everyone said to go get hyaluronic acid to fix it. But when I went to boots I saw that this was cheaper & had more product than the hyaluronic acid AND it had both ectoin & hyaluronic acid in it, so thought it would be better to get this. I am so glad I did. I thought the hyaluronic acid before & it was normal. Nothing special, just a normal hyaluronic acid but I think the ectoin in this really made the difference. Anyways, I saw results within 2 weeks. Used it day and night, stopped using all other skincare besides moisturiser in this 2w to let my skin heal. And it worked amazing. Redness died down a lot, skin is no longer dry and my face doesn't burn when I apply products anymore. You have to make sure your face is damp when using it so it works better, what I did was when I washed my hands (with hand wash, make sure your hands are always completely clean before skincare) instead Of drying my hands, I wipe them on my face which makes my face damp enough to use the product on top. It works really well & is so much less effort than using a spray bottle & if you were to splash your face with water, it would be too wet for the product to apply the product properly. So that method has been the best for me. For the last 4/5 months I've been usin
Really nice experiemnce with this product in terms of improving the skin hydration

This product when applied, a.m. and p.m. is like a layer of insulation. It works so well to give you that extra layer of moisture barrier protection. It does not leave the skin with any feeling of greasy or oiliness, just softness and very well hydrated.
I would say that it's not a terrible product, just not my favorite. It definitely reduces oil on my face. I just found it got flakey
This is the product I didn't think I needed! I'm a massive fan of The Inkey list all the products I use are brilliant, very fair price point, excellent value for money, would highly recommend

avis.titre: I have noticed a difference already
avis.texte: This really locks the moisture in and is perfect for my dry skin

avis.titre: Hydrating product that's easy to use
avis.texte: Product states use a pea size amount, I found this wasn't enough but in use more it does hydrate my face and helped my sun dried skin

avis.titre: Interesting product but no use for me
avis.texte: Lovely texture, easy to apply but I can't see this making any difference to my skin's hydration having tried for a couple of weeks. Not going to make a regular part of my skin care regime
Love this product it feels great when you first apply and I've definitely noticed a difference in my skin's hydration after using it for a few weeks.
No more flaky skin or dry patches, and reduced my redness significantly
